# Live Network Topology

This graph is built directly from the live API endpoint:

`https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph`

It shows:
- Nodes (callsigns / systems)
- Edges (routes + active links)
- Link quality as edge labels

---

<div id="cy" style="width: 100%; height: 800px; border: 1px solid #ddd;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.28.1/dist/cytoscape.min.js"></script>

<script>
async function loadGraph() {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph");
    const data = await res.json();

    const elements = [];

    // Add nodes
    data.nodes.forEach(n => {
        elements.push({
            data: {
                id: n.id,
                label: n.alias || n.id
            }
        });
    });

    // Add edges
    data.edges.forEach(e => {
        elements.push({
            data: {
                source: e.source,
                target: e.target,
                label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : ""
            }
        });
    });

    cytoscape({
        container: document.getElementById('cy'),

        elements: elements,

        style: [
            {
                selector: 'node',
                style: {
                    'label': 'data(label)',
                    'background-color': '#2b6cb0',
                    'color': '#fff',
                    'font-size': 8,
                    'text-valign': 'center',
                    'text-halign': 'center'
                }
            },
            {
                selector: 'edge',
                style: {
                    'width': 1,
                    'line-color': '#999',
                    'label': 'data(label)',
                    'font-size': 6,
                    'curve-style': 'bezier',
                    'text-rotation': 'autorotate'
                }
            }
        ],

        layout: {
            name: 'cose',
            animate: true,
            fit: true,
            padding: 30
        }
    });
}

loadGraph();
</script>
